submitted.rationale: I spread five EQE measurements along the line. Index 7 (Sb 0.437) gave the highest value, 0.0037%. Its neighbours were lower: 0.0023% at 0.523 and 0.0019% at 0.307. That makes the exact peak position uncertain.
